title.en: Financial Services and Markets (Prescribed Financial Institutions under Section 49) Regulations 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Financial Services and Markets (Prescribed Financial Institutions under Section 49) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 10 May 2024.
6. Revoke the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Prescribed Financial Institutions under Section 40A) Regulations 2020 (G.N. No. S 637/2020).
